_about: Verified internship / work-based-learning listings for NextStep. Every field was read on the official page (apply_url) on last_verified; null / 'Not specified' means the page did not state it. Some sites block automated requests (http_status_at_check 403/429/null) but were confirmed readable in a browser. Edit and run `python3 scripts/import_listings.py --only internships`; re-check links with `python3 scripts/check_links.py`.

internships.title: Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
internships.org: NYC Department of Youth & Community Development (DYCD)
internships.description: New York City's large summer jobs program that matches young people with paid summer work and career exploration. Placements are arranged through DYCD provider organizations.
internships.deadline_text: 2026 deadline was 3/13/26; 2027 dates not yet posted
internships.compensation_text: paid work experience each summer (rate not stated on page)
internships.skills: Workplace habits, career exploration, social/civic/leadership skills
evidence: The deadline to submit SYEP was 3/13/26. No further applications may be submitted.
connecting NYC youth between the ages of 14 and 24 with career exploration opportunities and paid work experience each summer
internships.verification_notes: Page still shows 'Apply to 2026 SYEP'; 2027 cycle not announced as of 2026-10-14. Based on the 2026 timing, the 2027 application would likely open in late winter, but that is not stated on the page.

internships.title: NYC Ladders for Leaders
internships.org: NYC Department of Youth & Community Development (DYCD)
internships.description: Competitive DYCD program that places high school and college students in paid professional summer internships with companies, nonprofits and government agencies. Interns complete 30 hours of pre-employment training first.
internships.eligibility: Youth ages 16-24 enrolled in high school or college; resident of one of the five NYC boroughs; prior paid or volunteer work experience
internships.deadline_text: 2026 cycle deadline was extended to 1/16/2026; 2027 dates not posted
internships.compensation_text: Paid professional summer internships (rate not stated on page)
internships.skills: Professional workplace skills; 30 hours pre-employment training
evidence: Youth between the ages of 16—24 who are enrolled in high school or college
Resident of one of the five boroughs of New York City
Prior work experience, either paid or volunteer
The deadline to submit the NYC Ladders for Leaders applications is extended to 1/16/2026.

The 2026 deadline was in January, so the 2027 window may open around late 2026; not confirmed. Third-party sources cite GPA requirements, but the official page does not, so none is recorded here.

internships.title: Work, Learn & Grow (WLG) Employment Program
internships.org: NYC Department of Youth & Community Development (DYCD)
internships.description: A 22-week, school-year follow-on to SYEP where public high school students earn pay, get academic support, explore careers and may earn college credit (including a CUNY course).
internships.eligibility: CareerReady WLG: ages 16-19 as of Oct 26, 2026, enrolled in a public high school, and a CareerReady SYEP 2026 participant. Special Initiatives WLG: ages 16-20, enrolled in high school or HSE program, and a Special Initiatives SYEP 2026 participant.
internships.skills: Work-readiness, postsecondary/career exploration, possible college credit
evidence: Work, Learn & Grow offers NYC youth between the ages of 16 and 20 a paid 22-week-long opportunity
You may qualify for CareerReady WLG if you are between the ages of 16 and 19 as of October 26, 2026, enrolled in a public high school, and were a participant of CareerReady SYEP 2026.
internships.verification_notes: Only students who did SYEP 2026 (CareerReady or Special Initiatives) are eligible. Page links to an online application and says to contact your SYEP provider, but shows no deadline. Ages on the cycle reference Oct 26, 2026, so this appears to be the current 2026-27 cycle.

internships.title: Science Research Mentoring Program (SRMP)
internships.location: American Museum of Natural History, Manhattan (plus Black Rock Forest fieldwork)
internships.description: A year-long program where NYC high school students do real science research in small teams with a museum scientist as mentor. It starts with a 4-week August Summer Institute and ends with a June colloquium.
internships.responsibilities: Meet mentors twice a week after school (Tue/Thu), attend 1-2 Friday workshops monthly, present a poster and talk at the June colloquium
internships.eligibility: Live and go to school in NYC; in 10th or 11th grade; passing classes for the last 3+ semesters; plus completed/taking a listed AMNH course OR attend a listed partner high school/program
internships.deadline_text: Applications for the Class of 2028 are expected to open in Winter 2027
internships.skills: Scientific research, poster and oral presentation
evidence: Applications for the Class of 2028 are expected to open in Winter 2027.
You must live and go to school in New York City, be in the 10th or 11th Grade, and be passing your classes
No, you don't need working papers for this, nor do you need to be a US citizen
internships.verification_notes: curl gets 403 (bot protection); page verified live by loading it in a browser. Stipend not mentioned on the official page (third-party sites cite one; not recorded). Partner-school list includes many Bronx schools. Schedule text on page still references summer 2025 dates.
